TxtSafeModeNetTitle: Restart to Safe Mode with Networking
TxtSafeModeNetDesc: Restarts Windows into Safe Mode with Networking (minimal drivers/services, but with network access), useful for troubleshooting, removing stubborn malware, or uninstalling problematic drivers. Windows will keep booting into Safe Mode until you turn it off again via System Configuration (msconfig) or a normal 'bootcfg' reset - a reminder is shown before restarting.
TxtUefiRestartDesc: Restarts directly into your motherboard's UEFI/BIOS setup screen, skipping the usual 'press DEL/F2' step. Requires a UEFI system (not legacy BIOS); if your PC doesn't support it, Windows will show an error and no change is made.
TxtNormalRestartDesc: Clears any pending Safe Mode boot flag and restarts Windows normally. Use this after you're done troubleshooting in Safe Mode, instead of going through System Configuration (msconfig) manually.
TxtDiskCleanupDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Disk Cleanup tool (cleanmgr), which lets you remove temporary files, old Windows Update files, Recycle Bin contents and more through a simple checklist.
TxtRamCleanDesc: Instantly clears the Standby List memory cache (the same native, safe action available in the Optimizations tab), reclaiming RAM held by closed apps without restarting anything.
TxtResourceMonitorDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Resource Monitor (resmon), a detailed, real-time view of CPU, memory, disk and network usage per process - more advanced than Task Manager.
TxtOptimizeDrivesDesc: Opens the built-in Windows 'Optimize Drives' tool (dfrgui), which defragments HDDs and sends TRIM to SSDs on a schedule you control.
TxtMemDiagDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Memory Diagnostic tool (mdsched), which restarts the PC and runs a thorough RAM hardware test - useful if you suspect faulty memory (random crashes/BSODs).
TxtExtScriptsWarning: These are independent, third-party open-source scripts (not part of WGO). Each one opens in its own window and requests admin rights on its own. Only run tools from sources you trust.
TxtAmdOptimizerDesc: A dedicated toolkit for AMD Radeon GPUs that targets the most common causes of driver crashes, black screens and stutter. It disables ULPS, Multi-Plane Overlay and HDCP, extends the TDR driver-timeout, turns off Fast Startup/Hibernation and the AMD Crash Defender service, fixes hardware-acceleration flicker in Chrome/Edge/Electron apps (Discord, Spotify), and unlocks Windows' hidden Ultimate Performance power plan. It creates a registry backup and, when possible, a System Restore Point before touching anything, and every change can be reverted from its own interface.
TxtMassgraveDesc: Launches the official Microsoft Activation Scripts (MASSGRAVE) project, a well-known open-source community tool for activating Windows and Microsoft Office via HWID, KMS38 or Online KMS. It opens an interactive text menu in a new console window; just follow the on-screen options to pick the activation method you want.
TxtUniGetUIDesc: A graphical interface for WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop, Pip, npm and other package managers. The winget/Chocolatey installer can trigger a "publisher could not be verified" warning, so this opens the official download page instead of installing silently.
LogExtScriptLaunched: {0} launched in a new window. Follow the instructions there.

AppBleachbitDesc: Free, open-source tool to clean disk clutter and protect privacy.
AppMoonlightDesc: Open-source game streaming client, used to connect to a Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream host.

AppNilesoftShellDesc: Powerful, highly customizable open-source context menu manager for File Explorer (MIT license).
AppOptiscalerClientDesc: Open-source desktop manager to install and update OptiScaler (DLSS/FSR/XeSS frame generation and upscaling injector) across your game library. Third-party GitHub project, not Microsoft-signed - review it before use.
AppFlowLauncherDesc: Fast, open-source keyboard launcher (Win key alternative) for apps, files, web search and plugins - a lighter, more extensible take on Windows Search / PowerToys Run.
AppShareXDesc: Free, open-source screenshot/screen-recording tool with built-in editing, annotation, GIF/video capture and one-click upload to dozens of destinations - a fuller-featured alternative to the built-in Snipping Tool.
